string-array.name: about_rows
string-array.item: Purpose: Vaultwarden server on Android 5+ / TV and STB
Platform: Android phones, TV boxes and STBs (Android 5+)
Access: web vault in browser plus Bitwarden app via HTTPS
Security: app PIN lock, SHA-256 verified updates, HTTPS-only
Performance: lightweight build for low-memory STBs
